description: 기상청_반응가스 관측자료 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청. 기상청에서 관측한 일산화탄소, 이산화황, 지상오존 등 반응가스 자료를 제공합니다. 기후변화감시자료는 매년 7월 업데이트되며, 파일 다운로드는 로그인 후 이용하실 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기상청. Its tags are 온실가스, 이산화탄소, 기후변화, 이산화황, 지상오존. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
